Linux AppImage

The AppImage also bundles shared libraries from Ubuntu (GTK 4, libadwaita, VTE, GLib, Pango, Cairo, HarfBuzz, FreeRDP, libusb and their dependencies) under the LGPL and other licences. They stay separate, replaceable shared libraries; the AppImage carries their copyright files, exact package versions and a written offer for their source code (usr/share/doc/rsshterm/bundled-libraries/). The .deb uses your distribution's copies instead.
